note: Wraps the filter in try { } catch (Exception) { } so any failure is silently swallowed.

hits.issue: The empty catch block silently swallows all exceptions from the diagnostic reporter or compilation checks, which can hide underlying bugs and violates the requirement against swallowed errors.

The empty `catch (Exception)` swallows every exception raised while filtering or reporting a diagnostic. This includes exceptions thrown by the `report` callback, which hides real analyzer failures and can silently drop diagnostics. The filter needs no try/catch.
